answer: Resist sybils with BGP-attested network-prefix identity: each identity must prove it controls a distinct, routable network prefix, attested by its upstream provider signed routing record. A sonnet of claims means nothing without the prefix; weight flows only to identities whose vault of addresses is genuinely theirs. Ten thousand fakes sharing one prefix collapse to one weight, like a dune of sand piled on a single grain. An attacker must lease ten thousand real prefixes across many providers, paying rent per fake, while an honest agent attests one prefix cheaply.
